summary: Correct changed-file coverage normalization so repository-root .github workflow paths remain repository-root paths.
reason: The first standalone public pull-request run showed that normalize_declared used lstrip("./"), which removed the leading dot from .github/... and misclassified the active enforcement workflow as a skill-relative path. The correction removes only an actual ./ prefix and preserves repository-root .github paths. Live GitHub Actions then accepted full changed-file coverage and ran 28 regression tests successfully before the intentionally unresolved queue gate, providing the runtime evidence needed to close this bounded correction.
